entries.note: Chinese wording 快件电子信息已经收到. The waybill's information reached Torbon, before it has the goods.
Chinese wording 快件到达作业中心. The goods reached Torbon's warehouse in Yiwu.

entries.wording: 已装柜 , 预计…号的船期 , 具体离港时间以实际为准
entries.note: "Loaded into the container, sailing expected on the day named, the actual departure decides." The day varies.

entries.wording: 官网更新开船时间 , 预计…号离港 , 请知悉
entries.note: "The shipping line's site updated the sailing date: departure expected on the day named." The container waits at the port.

entries.wording: 已开船 , 预计美国时间…号到达洛杉矶港
entries.note: "The ship has sailed, due at the port of Los Angeles on the US day named."

entries.wording: 货物到达港口 , 正在排队卸船中
entries.note: "The goods reached the port and wait their turn to be unloaded."
"The container is expected to be collected from the port on the US day named."
"Booking a delivery slot at the warehouse." The destination is an Amazon warehouse.

entries.wording: 预约美国时间…号递送入仓
entries.note: "Delivery into the warehouse booked for the US day named."

entries.wording: …号已送仓,POD已回传。后续如有疑问,请在15个工作日内及时联系我司。
entries.note: "Delivered to the warehouse on the day named, proof of delivery returned; contact us within 15 working days with any question." The reply's summary status is CC, 派送妥投, at the same time.
